content.text: MrBeast play spans a wide-ranging catalogue built from partnerships with respected studios across the industry. Every category is accessible directly from the main navigation menu, and a provider filter in each section lets you browse by studio.
Slots form the backbone of our catalogue.
Inside the slots section, three curated sub-tabs help you navigate:

items: **New**: recently launched titles available to try in demo mode using practice chips
**Top**: the highest-traffic slots on our platform, refreshed regularly based on actual play data
**Hot**: games currently showing strong payout activity and pulling the most player interest

content.text: Every slot listing includes a Demo button. Winnings earned in demo mode hold no cash value and cannot be withdrawn.
MrBeast play live section streams real-time games from professional studios staffed by trained croupiers.

items: **Roulette**: multiple table configurations with live hosts
**Live shows**: hosted formats featuring real presenters and interactive mechanics

content.text: Live games require a funded account. Demo mode does not exist in this section.
Our Crash section runs on a completely different mechanic compared to traditional slot machines.
There are no reels, no paylines, and no symbol combinations; instead:

items: Place your stake before each round starts
Watch a multiplier climb upward in real time
Cash out at any point to lock in your current multiplier as a win
If the crash triggers before you cash out, your stake is lost

content.text: Crash games reward timing and quick decision-making. They attract players who want faster, more interactive gameplay than standard slots provide.

Beyond the live section, MrBeast Canada carries a selection of standard table games powered by a random number generator. These include blackjack, baccarat, roulette variants, and multiple poker formats. Use the search bar at the top of any page to locate a specific title in seconds \- type a few letters or the full name and results appear instantly.
